captions.detailed: A benchtop teaching microscope featuring a broad, off-white supporting base and arm, a vertical cylindrical focusing column, and a black rectangular mechanical stage. Mounted on the stage is a black side carriage, while a small black diaphragm lever is positioned underneath. An inclined monocular tube sits at the top, terminating in a rotating objective turret with multiple small cylindrical objectives. The optical body slides prismatically along the vertical column, the objective turret rotates continuously, the side carriage slides along the stage guide, and the diaphragm lever rotates on a short pivot under the stage.
captions.instruction: Generate a CadQuery Python script for a benchtop teaching microscope. The model should include a broad supporting base and arm, a vertical focusing column, a black mechanical stage with a side carriage, a diaphragm lever underneath, and an inclined monocular tube with a rotating objective turret. Define prismatic joints for the vertical focus and stage carriage, and revolute/continuous joints for the diaphragm lever and objective turret.
captions.factory: Constructs the microscope using an assembly of parts. The base, arm, and stage are modeled using Box and Cylinder primitives combined with boolean transformations. The optical body includes an inclined monocular tube and a cylindrical objective turret with multiple smaller objective cylinders. Four joints are defined: a prismatic joint for the optical body sliding vertically on the focusing column, a continuous joint for the rotating objective turret, a prismatic joint for the side carriage sliding along the stage guide, and a revolute joint for the diaphragm lever pivoting beneath the stage.
